learningGoals: Understand the concepts of measurement, size, and spatial awareness. 📐
Compare lengths and heights of different everyday objects. 📏
Learn to measure things using non-standard units like handspans and footsteps. ✋
Develop vocabulary related to heavy, light, long, and short. ⚖️
teachingTips: Use real gift boxes or containers at home to show the difference between big and small. 📦
Encourage your child to measure the dining table or their bed using their handspans. ✋
Hold a heavy object in one hand and a light one in the other, and ask them to feel the difference. ⚖️
Use positive reinforcement when they correctly identify which item is longer or shorter. 🌟

funActivities.title: Measure the Room 👣
funActivities.description: Ask your child to measure the length of the living room using their footsteps and write down the number.

funActivities.title: Heavy or Light? ⚖️
funActivities.description: Give them a pillow and a book. Ask them to hold both and tell you which one feels heavier.

funActivities.title: Ribbon Hunt 🎀
funActivities.description: Give them pieces of yarn or string of different lengths and ask them to arrange them from shortest to longest.
